jutsu.name: Buried Memory Field
jutsu.battleDescription: Phantom earth swallows the enemy's senses and buries their memory.

jutsu.name: Hollow Voice Cyclone
jutsu.battleDescription: A cyclone of hollow voices tears through the enemy and feeds on their pain.

jutsu.name: Mud Coffin Bind
jutsu.battleDescription: Heavy mud surges up and hardens around the target, locking them in place.

jutsu.name: Cyclone Cutter
jutsu.battleDescription: Whirling blades of wind carve through the air toward the target.

jutsu.name: Stone Eye Mirage
jutsu.battleDescription: The ground seems to twist as a stone mirage clouds the enemy's sight.

jutsu.name: Whispering Gale
jutsu.battleDescription: A whispering wind carries doubt that leaves the enemy exposed.

jutsu.name: Rising Gale Combo
jutsu.battleDescription: A rising flurry of wind-fast strikes batters the enemy upward.

jutsu.name: Flicker
jutsu.battleDescription: The user vanishes and reappears on a nearby open tile.

jutsu.name: Stone Needle Volley
jutsu.battleDescription: Jagged stone needles erupt from the earth in a punishing volley.

jutsu.name: Iron Sand Burst
jutsu.battleDescription: A cloud of iron-laced sand detonates outward in a grinding burst.

jutsu.name: Stoneheart Meditation
jutsu.battleDescription: The user sinks into a stone-still trance, fortifying every attribute.

jutsu.name: Boulder Heel Drop
jutsu.battleDescription: A crushing heel drops like a falling boulder onto the enemy.
